converter_application.gui: Same tested folder-picker/worker flow as 0.2; branding updated, conversion verified through the frozen executable.

animation_performance.method: mGBA libretro; one Right press from first GBA cart, 100 startup frames, count emulated frames until selected index becomes 1; 59.7275 Hz. Includes input observation/handoff, not a physical LCD measurement.
animation_performance.v0.3_method: Real preview ROM, one Right press, count input-to-settled display frames using motion marker; rapid tap checks use move counter. Not a fixed-60-FPS or physical-LCD claim.

v0.4.method: 180 display frames after 60 held warm-up frames per platform. The spring controller ticks every VBlank, independent of rendering; no SD IO in the preview. Each result counts changed displayed images, including the physical display-frame budget.

v0.5.method: 180 display frames after 60 held warm-up frames per platform. Spring controller ticks each VBlank; steady 200 ms repeat, no loading/presentation gate. Decoder comparison uses prior Thumb conversion versus new ARM conversion on identical staged pixels. No SD IO in preview.

audio.scope: Offline waveform level and range; actual speaker loudness depends on hardware. Smooth limiting raises the quieter body while keeping peaks within signed-8 range.

navigation.source: Slot spring equations; GBA-specific steady 200 ms repeat
navigation.scope: Compiled shared controller versus independent float spring and slower hold schedule, with no render acknowledgements. Does not measure physical SD stalls or LCD cadence.

motion.scope: Shared GBA renderer and continuously retargeted spring. Settling includes a nearly invisible subpixel tail, not an input lockout. Physical SD reads and LCD cadence require cartridge testing.

startup_save.scope: Actual DE Check_save_flag compiled against mocked save-info and SD IO: absent flag, success, failed write, failed path, retry. No physical save write-back claim.

boot_entry.startup_after_first_video_callback: 14 consecutive fully black frames before splash
boot_entry.scope: Header compatibility with working 0.1 binaries, early-entry ARM execution in mGBA. Physical cartridge recognition remains to be confirmed.
boot_entry.diagnosis: 0.2 changed the first word from 0xEA00002E to an end-of-ROM branch. This is the suspected cause of the reported no-kernel-found error; the exact loader acceptance check has not been independently inspected.

frontend_host.streaming_checks: Twenty-game holds/reversals across both styles and all systems, 24-row reads, no partial image exposure, cancel/retry, missing/malformed/failing reads; 36 endpoint image comparisons and 288 full-versus-incremental comparisons.
frontend_host.scope: Actual common/slot_frontend.h with mocked hardware/SD IO, real converter BMPs, settings faults, streaming cache, empty/missing/error/512-entry shelves, launch delegation and menus. Does not measure physical SD latency.

emulator.scope: Shared renderer and pure C format/navigation logic; flashcart IO and ROM launch require hardware.
